record: Backed the Ratepayer Protection Act, passed by the House, to stop large data centers (including AI data centers) from pushing up household utility costs.
Helped introduce the bipartisan MATCH Act to tighten export controls on chipmaking equipment, framed as winning the AI race against China.
Co-signed a letter with 40 colleagues urging the Medicare agency to reject a model that uses artificial intelligence for medical necessity decisions (prior authorization).
grade_reason: Her AI-related remarks are about AI data centers raising electricity bills (2026), AI competition with China (2025 and 2026) and AI in Medicare coverage decisions (2025), all level D. No statement acknowledging catastrophic AI risk was found in seven web searches or on her official site.
